exercises.title: Pairs of words (Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct word for each sentence.

items.prompt: I keep the ice cream in the ____ — it needs to stay frozen.
items.explanation: freezer làm đông (âm độ); fridge chỉ giữ lạnh.

items.prompt: I pull the ____ down at night. It has lots of thin pieces of plastic.
items.explanation: blind là rèm sáo/cuốn kéo lên xuống; curtains là rèm vải kéo ngang.

items.prompt: I wash my hands and brush my teeth at the ____.
items.explanation: sink = bồn rửa; bath = bồn tắm để nằm.

exercises.title: Building a conversation (Ex. 14)
exercises.instruction: Read the sentences from the phone call between Giorgio and Andrew Taylor. Choose the best sentence, A, B or C, for each gap.

items.prompt: Andrew: Good afternoon, Prime Location Agency, Andrew Taylor speaking. ____

options.text: Can I check your student status?
Can I give you my student status?
Have you got time to speak? Can you check my student status?

items.explanation: Andrew (người môi giới) muốn kiểm tra tư cách sinh viên của khách → "Can I check…?"

items.prompt: Andrew: Thank you for your call, I have some questions for you. ____

options.text: I hope that you don't mind.

items.explanation: Lịch sự: "I hope you don't mind" = mong bạn không phiền.

items.prompt: Andrew: First of all, ____ – in a room on campus or in private accommodation?

options.text: Where you do want to live?
Where do you want to live?

items.explanation: Wh- + do + you + V.

items.prompt: Giorgio: I'm not sure. ____

options.text: You can give me some advice?
Can you give me some advice?
Can give me you some advice?

items.explanation: Can + S + V?

items.prompt: Andrew: Tell me a little about your personality. ____

options.text: Do you be a sociable person?

items.explanation: Câu hỏi với be: đảo "are" lên trước chủ ngữ.

items.prompt: Andrew: OK, that's great. ____ sometimes have a quiet room where you can study in private?
items.explanation: "like to + V" và cần trợ động từ do.

items.prompt: Andrew: …it takes a long time to travel to university. ____
items.explanation: What + do + you + think?

items.prompt: Giorgio: I'm not sure. ____
items.explanation: What does + từ + mean? = từ … nghĩa là gì?

exercises.title: Complete the conversation (Ex. 16)
exercises.instruction: Read the end of the conversation. Match each of Andrew's answers with what Giorgio says JUST BEFORE it.

items.left: Andrew: "I think the house has superfast broadband. The Wi-Fi is sometimes very busy and slow on campus."
items.right: Yes. Is the Wi-Fi connection better on campus or in the private house?
items.explanation: Andrew trả lời về Wi-Fi → Giorgio vừa hỏi về Wi-Fi (D).

items.left: Andrew: "You also have a TV in the private room, so you can connect your computer and play games on the TV."
items.right: Oh, that's good to know. I really like playing online games, you see.
items.explanation: Andrew nói thêm về chơi game trên TV → Giorgio vừa nói thích chơi game online (G).

items.left: Andrew: "No, but you or your roommate can bring one."
items.right: Oh, great. Do the rooms on campus also have TVs?
items.explanation: "No… can bring one" = trả lời câu hỏi Yes/No về TV (A).

items.left: Andrew: "Yes, it's good because you can study together."
items.right: Really? I like the idea of having a roommate.
items.explanation: Học cùng nhau → nói về bạn cùng phòng (B).

items.left: Andrew: "Would you like to discuss everything with your parents?"
items.right: Yes, but I prefer to study alone. Oh, I don't know what to choose.
items.explanation: Giorgio phân vân → Andrew gợi ý hỏi bố mẹ (E).

items.left: Andrew: "OK. Let me email you some information."
items.right: Yes, that's a good idea. They always give me good advice.
items.explanation: Giorgio đồng ý hỏi bố mẹ → Andrew gửi thông tin (F).

exercises.title: Complete the grammar table (Ex. 11)
exercises.instruction: Complete the positive (+), negative (−) and question (?) forms.

items.prompt: (−) I ____ a student.
items.explanation: Phủ định của be: am not.

items.prompt: (+) I ____ with my parents.
items.explanation: I + V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: (−) He ____ ____ with his parents.
items.explanation: He/She + doesn't + V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: (?) ____ he live with his parents?
items.explanation: Câu hỏi ngôi thứ ba: Does + he + V?

items.prompt: (+) I ____ speak English very well.
items.explanation: can + V.

items.prompt: (?) ____ I ____ English?
items.explanation: Can + S + V?

items.prompt: (?) What do you ____ to study?
items.explanation: What + do + you + V?

items.prompt: (?) Why ____ he want to live in the UK?
items.explanation: Why + does + he + V?

exercises.title: The car / I play games (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence in the form in brackets: (+) positive, (−) negative, (?) question.

items.prompt: The car ____ in the garage. (−)
items.explanation: be phủ định.

items.prompt: ____ ____ ____ in the garage? (?)
items.explanation: Đảo is lên đầu.

items.prompt: Where ____ the car? (?)
items.explanation: Where + is + S?

items.prompt: I ____ ____ games on my phone in my bedroom. (−)
items.explanation: I don't + V.

items.prompt: ____ you ____ games on your phone in your bedroom? (?)
items.explanation: Do you + V?

items.prompt: What games ____ you ____ on your phone? (?)
items.explanation: What + do + you + V?

items.prompt: Can ____ ____ a game on my phone later? (?)
items.explanation: Can I + V?

exercises.title: Giorgio's morning (Ex. 18)
exercises.instruction: Read Giorgio's description of his day and choose the correct answer, A, B or C.

stimulus.text: Every weekday morning, my alarm goes (1) ____ at 8:30am. This gives me enough time to get ready before my lectures start at 10:00am. Then, I (2) ____ up and go downstairs. I'm often too tired to eat breakfast, so I sometimes go to the (3) ____ and just get some juice. I always talk to my housemates if they are there, in the (4) ____. After that, I head back upstairs to get ready. I go to the bathroom, (5) ____ my teeth and sometimes (6) ____ my room. When it's time to leave, I pack my bag and go to college. At the end of the day when I get back home, I sometimes help the others with the (7) ____ – if we don't do it, all the rooms we share get very messy. When the house is clean again, we usually spend some time in the living room. We sit down together on the (8) ____ and play games online for a while. We're always happy when we get the chance to do this, as it helps us relax. Before I go to sleep, I sit at my (9) ____ and do my homework. I never forget to do it. At the weekend, I can finally relax. I have a lie (10) ____ until about 11:30am.
stimulus.caption: Ex. 18 — Giorgio's day (đã che các từ cần điền)

items.prompt: Every weekday morning, my alarm goes ____ at 8:30am.
items.explanation: alarm goes off = chuông báo thức reo.

items.prompt: Then, I ____ up and go downstairs.
items.explanation: get up = thức dậy.

items.prompt: I sometimes go to the ____ and just get some juice.
items.explanation: Nước ép để trong tủ lạnh (fridge).

items.prompt: I always talk to my housemates if they are there, in the ____.
items.explanation: Đang lấy nước ép → ở bếp.

items.prompt: I go to the bathroom, ____ my teeth…
items.explanation: brush teeth = đánh răng.

items.prompt: …and sometimes ____ my room.
items.explanation: tidy my room = dọn phòng.

items.prompt: I sometimes help the others with the ____ – if we don't do it, all the rooms get very messy.
items.explanation: housework = việc nhà (khác homework = bài tập về nhà).

items.prompt: We sit down together on the ____ and play games online.
items.explanation: "sit down together" trong phòng khách → sofa.

items.prompt: Before I go to sleep, I sit at my ____ and do my homework.
items.explanation: Ngồi vào bàn học (desk).

items.prompt: At the weekend, I have a lie ____ until about 11:30am.
items.explanation: have a lie in = ngủ nướng.

exercises.title: Rules for adverb position (Ex. 19–21)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer.

items.prompt: With the verb "to be", the frequency adverb goes ____ the verb.
items.explanation: I am often too tired… → sau "am".

items.prompt: With other verbs, the frequency adverb goes ____ the verb.
items.explanation: We usually spend time… → trước "spend".

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: I am never late for school.
I never am late for school.
I am late never for school.

items.explanation: never đứng sau am.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: I forget never to do my homework.
I never forget to do my homework.
Never I forget to do my homework.

items.explanation: never đứng trước forget.

exercises.title: Make questions (G&V Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence as a Yes/No question.

items.prompt: It is okay to come to your house this evening.
items.answer: Is it okay to come to your house this evening?
items.explanation: be → đảo Is lên đầu.

items.prompt: You can check that the windows are all closed before we go out.
items.answer: Can you check that the windows are all closed before we go out?
items.explanation: can → đảo Can lên đầu.

items.prompt: You are in the living room next to the kitchen.
items.answer: Are you in the living room next to the kitchen?
items.explanation: are → Are you…?

items.prompt: You want to sit in the garden.
items.answer: Do you want to sit in the garden?
items.explanation: Động từ thường → thêm Do.

items.prompt: You help your parents with the housework.
items.answer: Do you help your parents with the housework?
items.explanation: Do + you + V? (câu ví dụ của sách)

items.prompt: The apartments in the UK are very different from the apartments in your country.
items.answer: Are the apartments in the UK very different from the apartments in your country?
items.explanation: are → đảo Are lên trước chủ ngữ số nhiều.

exercises.title: Correct the adverb position (G&V Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Some sentences have the adverb or the words in the wrong place. Write the correct sentence (if the sentence is already correct, copy it).

items.prompt: In my country, people live usually in apartments and not houses.
items.answer: In my country, people usually live in apartments and not houses.
items.explanation: usually đứng trước động từ thường live.

items.prompt: My uncle keeps his car always in the garage because it is very expensive.
items.answer: My uncle always keeps his car in the garage because it is very expensive.
items.explanation: always trước keeps.

items.prompt: Our sink sometimes makes a very strange noise.
items.answer: Our sink sometimes makes a very strange noise.
items.explanation: Câu đúng.

items.prompt: I have a housemate but I don't see very often him – he is always studying.
items.answer: I have a housemate but I don't see him very often – he is always studying.
items.explanation: very often đứng cuối câu, sau tân ngữ him (hoặc: I don't very often see him).

items.prompt: In your country, do people usually celebrate their 18th birthday with a party?
items.answer: In your country, do people usually celebrate their 18th birthday with a party?
items.explanation: Câu đúng: usually đứng sau chủ ngữ, trước động từ celebrate.

items.prompt: Do you prefer to do your homework in your bedroom?
items.answer: Do you prefer to do your homework in your bedroom?
items.explanation: Câu đúng.

exercises.title: The purpose of the email (Ex. 26)
exercises.instruction: Read Gavin's email to Giorgio. What is the main reason Gavin is writing?

stimulus.text:
Hi Giorgio,

So, we're both university students now! I like my room on campus very much. Are you on campus or in private accommodation? Are you happy with your choice of where you're living? Please tell me about your room. What other things do you like about where you live?

Write soon,
Gavin
stimulus.caption: Email from Gavin

items.prompt: The main reason for writing is…

options.text: to say thank you to Giorgio.
to tell Giorgio that he likes university.

items.explanation: Bài mẫu của sách chọn C: Gavin kể mình thích phòng ở trường và hỏi chuyện Giorgio. Không có lời cảm ơn hay xin lời khuyên.

exercises.title: Capital letters and punctuation (Ex. 27)
exercises.instruction: Giorgio's email has no capital letters or punctuation. For each part, choose the CORRECT version.

items.prompt: hi gavin
items.explanation: Viết hoa chữ đầu và tên riêng; dấu phẩy sau lời chào.

items.prompt: i live in private accommodation i am very happy with my room

options.text: I live in private accommodation, i am very happy with my room.
I live in private accommodation. I am very happy with my room.
i live in private accommodation. I am very happy with my room

items.explanation: Đại từ I luôn viết hoa; hai ý → hai câu, mỗi câu kết bằng dấu chấm.

items.prompt: the Wi-Fi here is very fast i am happy about that

options.text: The Wi-Fi here is very fast. I am happy about that.
The Wi-Fi here is very fast I am happy about that.
the Wi-Fi here is very fast. i am happy about that.

items.explanation: Câu mới bắt đầu bằng chữ in hoa; có dấu chấm giữa hai câu.

items.prompt: do you have Wi-Fi in your room is the food nice where you live

options.text: Do you have Wi-Fi in your room. Is the food nice where you live.
Do you have Wi-Fi in your room? Is the food nice where you live?
Do you have Wi-Fi in your room, is the food nice where you live?

items.explanation: Hai câu hỏi → hai dấu chấm hỏi.

items.prompt: write soon giorgio
items.explanation: Câu kết viết hoa, dấu phẩy, tên ở dòng dưới và viết hoa.

exercises.title: Write a reply to Giorgio (Ex. 28)
exercises.instruction: Imagine you are Gavin. Write a reply to Giorgio (60–80 words): answer his two questions ("Do you have Wi-Fi in your room?" and "Is the food nice where you live?"), then ask Giorgio two questions about his accommodation. Remember to use capital letters and correct punctuation.

checklist: Mở đầu "Hi Giorgio," và kết "Write soon, Gavin"
Trả lời câu hỏi về Wi-Fi
Trả lời câu hỏi về đồ ăn
Hỏi lại Giorgio 2 câu về chỗ ở
Viết hoa, dấu chấm và dấu hỏi đúng
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Hi Giorgio,

Thanks for your email. Yes, I have Wi-Fi in my room, but it is sometimes slow in the evening because lots of students use it. The food here is quite nice. I live in catered accommodation, so I eat breakfast and dinner in the canteen every day. My favourite meal is the pasta on Fridays!

How many people live in your house? Do you cook your own meals?

Write soon,
Gavin
commonErrors: Không trả lời đủ 2 câu hỏi của Giorgio
Quên dấu chấm hỏi ở câu hỏi

exercises.title: Who is speaking? (Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Giorgio phones Andrew Taylor. Who is more likely to say each sentence?

items.explanation: Người môi giới hỏi để kiểm tra tư cách sinh viên.

items.text: What do you want to study?
I live with my parents at the moment.

items.explanation: Người thuê hỏi chỗ ở nằm đâu.

exercises.title: Speaking: weekdays and weekends (Ex. 17, 23)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 15–25 seconds.

items.prompt: On a weekday morning, what time does your alarm go off?
items.sampleAnswer: My alarm usually goes off at six fifteen, but I always press snooze once! I get up at about six thirty because my school starts at seven fifteen.
items.sampleNote: Dùng đúng cụm "alarm goes off" của bài.

items.prompt: Do you like to have a lie in at the weekend?
items.sampleAnswer: Yes, I love it. On Sundays I usually have a lie in until nine o'clock because I'm tired after a long week. Then I have a big breakfast with my family.
items.sampleNote: Yes → lý do → hoạt động tiếp theo.

items.prompt: Describe a typical day for you at the weekend.
items.sampleAnswer: On Saturdays I usually help my mum with the housework in the morning. In the afternoon, I often meet my friends at a café, and in the evening we sometimes watch a film at home.
items.sampleNote: Theo trình tự sáng – chiều – tối + trạng từ tần suất.

exercises.title: Campus or private? (Ex. 24)
exercises.instruction: Which accommodation that Andrew Taylor sent to Giorgio has each feature?

items.text: Five minutes' walk to the lecture hall
25-minute bus ride to the lecture hall
Fast Wi-Fi (sometimes slow at busy times)
Live with two other students and the homeowner
Single bed – no pillows or sheets provided
Double bed – pillows and sheets provided

exercises.title: Speaking: which accommodation would you choose? (Ex. 25)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 20–30 seconds. Give your choice + a reason (because) + a detail.

items.prompt: In your opinion, what is more important, having superfast Wi-Fi or having a short walk to lectures?
items.sampleAnswer: For me, a short walk to lectures is more important. I often get up late, so if I live five minutes from the lecture hall, I will never be late. Wi-Fi is useful, but I can always study in the library.
items.sampleNote: Chọn rõ ràng → lý do cá nhân → nhắc lại lựa chọn kia (but…).

items.prompt: Are you unhappy about the idea of sharing a bathroom with other students? Or does it not matter to you?
items.sampleAnswer: To be honest, I don't really like it. I prefer a private bathroom because I can take my time in the morning. When I share a bathroom with my brother, we often argue about it!
items.sampleNote: Thêm ví dụ thật từ cuộc sống.

items.prompt: What do you think about having all your meals included?
items.sampleAnswer: I think it's a great idea, because I can't cook very well and it saves a lot of time. However, the food in a canteen is sometimes boring, so I would also like to cook at the weekend.
items.sampleNote: Nêu cả ưu điểm và nhược điểm (However…).

items.prompt: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living with lots of other students?
items.sampleAnswer: The main advantage is that you can make lots of new friends and you never feel lonely. The disadvantage is that it can be very noisy, especially at night, so it is difficult to study or sleep.
items.sampleNote: Dùng "The main advantage is… The disadvantage is…".
